properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PascalCoin protocol signing curve — the wallet's actual account-key curve. Production sites (missed by the deterministic pass, reported as findings): lib/util/pascal_util.dart:7 generates keypairs on the default curve, lib/store/account/account.dart signs every operation with it. Changeable here only by the PascalCoin protocol (consensus-bound), not by the app alone.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PascalCoin protocol key types 715/716: pascaldart can generate keypairs on these curves (keys_test.dart CURVE_INSTANCES) and the wallet can derive/import keys on them (wallet.dart Keys.fromPrivateKey). The app generates secp256k1 by default; these remain supported protocol curves. Consensus-bound — replaceable only at protocol level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CBC-PKCS7 available in the app's crypto dependency stack (pascaldart ^2.0.0, exercised here with NIST SP 800-38A known-answer vectors). Quantum-resistant in practice; below CNSA 2.0 preference.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vault.java:35 is production: Bottlerocket SharedPreferenceVaultFactory (com.bottlerocketstudios:vault:1.4.2, android/app/build.gradle:88) AES-256 encrypted SharedPreferences, keyed via Android Keystore on modern devices; stores the 64-byte SecureRandom secret that guards the legacy Salsa20 private-key storage. Note: the same call consumes the hardcoded AUTOMATICALLY_KEYED_PRESHARED_SECRET (Vault.java:19) — reported as a separate finding (pre-M devices key the vault with a static shipped secret).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vault.generateKey() (Vault.java:63-66) creates the 64-byte device secret with java.security.SecureRandom; stored Base64 in the AES-256 vault and fetched by the Dart side over MethodChannel 'fappchannel' as key material for the legacy Salsa20 private-key/PIN encryption (lib/util/vault.dart:76,86). Proper CSPRNG — the strong link in the legacy chain.
